newsitem.title: USA: Redbook's earlier release time to start Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Redbook's earlier release time to start Tuesday.

text.p: Lynch, Jones and Ryan Inc said its newly named Redbook Retail Averages will be released to paying subscribers at 1405 EDT/1805 GMT beginning Tuesday.
The financial press will be permitted to release the data 35 minutes later at 1440 EDT/1840 GMT, Redbook added.

The change is a permament one and was designed so as not to interfere with the release of the outcome of various Federal Open Market Committee meetings and other announcements, Redbook said earlier this month.
